description: Format references from structured fields in APA 7, MLA 9, Chicago author-date (17th), Harvard (Cite Them Right) or IEEE, for books, book chapters, journal articles, web pages, newspaper/magazine articles, videos and reports. Handles author-count rules (et al.), initials, organisations as authors, editions, page ranges (MLA 127-53), DOIs, URLs and access dates, and title case for MLA/Chicago/IEEE. Returns each citation as plain text and HTML (italics as <i>), the in-text citation, missing-field hints, and the whole list as a bibliography sorted for the style (numbered for IEEE). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/citation-gen/

autoCase.description: Apply title case where the style wants it (MLA, Chicago, IEEE book titles). Default true.

authors.description: Authors in order (for a video: the creator/channel).

last.description: Family name, or the organisation name when org is true.

container.description: Journal / book (for a chapter) / website / newspaper / platform name.

edition.description: Edition, e.g. "2" or "2nd ed." (1st is omitted).

editors.description: chapter: editors as "First Last; First Last" or "Last, First; …".

title.description: Title of the work (book, article, chapter, page, video, report).

style.description: Citation style: apa, mla, chicago, harvard or ieee.

name: text_citation
title: Citation generator
